eslint.config.mjs: The lint rules themselves. eslint loads this, and the `lint` step in .github/workflows/js-unit-suite.yml is the gate on it.
src/workbench/lissajous/lissajous_page.j: tools/lissajous.html's entry module. Importing it builds the page: it calls bootstrapTool() at the top level, which stands up a WebGL scene the fake DOM cannot provide. Its math is tests/lissajous_math.test.js's subject, its rational lock and the lock's history-restore agreement are scripts/lissajous-probe.mjs's, and page loading is scripts/browser-smoke.mjs's.
src/workbench/mobius/mobius_page.js: tools/mobius.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene at the top level; its transforms are covered by tests/mobius_transforms.test.js, its complex-plane pads by scripts/mobius-probe.mjs; tests/mobius_page_handlers.test.js exercises handlers extracted as text (without module coverage measurement), and scripts/browser-smoke.mjs covers page loading.
src/workbench/palettes/palettes_page.js: tools/palettes.html's entry module. Importing it binds the page DOM at the top level; its math, recipe model, sliders and hue-key wheel are covered by their unit tests, its strip-zoom and hue-key-wheel pointer wiring by scripts/palettes-probe.mjs; tests/palettes_page_handlers.test.js exercises handlers extracted as text (without module coverage measurement), and scripts/browser-smoke.mjs covers page loading.
src/workbench/solids/solids_page.js: tools/solids.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene and loads the WASM engine at the top level; its helpers are covered by their unit tests, its op-chain reorder by scripts/solids-probe.mjs; tests/solids_page_handlers.test.js exercises handlers extracted as text (without module coverage measurement), and scripts/browser-smoke.mjs covers page loading.
src/app/main.js: index.html's entry module, whose body is `void bootstrap()`. Importing it starts the simulator, which is why bootstrap.js stays separately importable and tests/bootstrap.test.js covers it there.
vendor-importmap.js: An IIFE the page loads by script tag, not a module. tests/vendor-importmap.test.js evaluates its source in a node:vm sandbox, which is not a module load.
scripts/browser-smoke.mjs: Drives headless Chrome over every manifest-served page. The reusable browser workflow runs it, and there is no part of it a unit test could reach without a browser.
scripts/record-module-loads.mjs: Loaded through NODE_OPTIONS before its own loader hook exists; a missing recorder leaves source modules uncovered and fails the roster gate.
